callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized for proj_dir if a CodeGraph index exists and is accessible; returns a falsy value otherwise

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.pre_condition: The instance is a valid CodeGraphExtractor obtained from from_proj_dir; language is a registered language key string; filepath is a path to a source file within the indexed project
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples for all functions in filepath if the language and file are indexed by CodeGraph; returns None if the file or language is not indexed
